# Sheetal Laser Art Gallery (Bless Tree)

> Laser cutting and engraving studio in Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, India. We design and make custom laser cut wooden and acrylic art: temple replicas, awards and honour plaques, wall art and decor, standing cutouts, and educational wooden puzzles. Every piece can be personalised and is made to order.

- Business name: Sheetal Laser Art Gallery, brand Bless Tree
- Address: 181/1, North Civil Line, Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9412678517
- Email: ajayjain104@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/blesstree.in
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/blesstree
- Ordering: enquiries and custom orders are taken over WhatsApp, phone or the website forms. Prices are quoted on enquiry.

## Categories

- [Temple Replicas](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/category/temple-replicas): Detailed laser-cut replicas that bring devotion, heritage and architecture into your space.
- [Awards & Honours](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/category/awards-honours): Custom awards, trophies and honour plaques made for ceremonies, schools, events and special guests.
- [Wall Art & Decor](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/category/wall-art-decor): Devotional, floral and jaali wall art made to add warmth and character to meaningful spaces.
- [Cutouts & Characters](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/category/cutouts-characters): Colourful standing cutouts of heroes, deities and favourite characters for homes, schools and events.
- [Wooden Puzzles](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/category/wooden-puzzles): Educational wooden jigsaw puzzles that make playful, memorable gifts for curious minds.

## Temple Replicas

- [Hastinapur Jain Temple](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/hastinapur-jain-temple): A detailed devotional replica celebrating the Jain heritage and sacred architecture of Hastinapur.
- [Tijara Ji Jain Temple](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/tijara-ji-jain-temple): A softly lit, finely layered replica of the Tijara Ji Jain Mandir, made for devotional display and gifting.
- [Shri Mahavir Ji Digambar Jain Temple](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/shri-mahavir-ji-digambar-jain-temple): A detailed devotional temple replica celebrating Shri Mahavir Ji and Digambar Jain heritage.
- [Gurudwara Sri Hemkund Sahib](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/gurudwara-sri-hemkund-sahib): A detailed devotional replica celebrating the sacred architecture and spiritual heritage of Sri Hemkund Sahib.
- [Shri Ram Mandir Ayodhya](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/shri-ram-mandir-ayodhya): A detailed devotional replica celebrating the sacred Ram Mandir in Ayodhya.

## Awards & Honours

- [Ahilyabai Holkar Display Case Award](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/ahilyabai-holkar-display-case-award): A premium honour piece in a clear acrylic display case, with personalised photo medallions and name plate.
- [Lokmata Ahilyabai Holkar Jayanti Award](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/lokmata-ahilyabai-holkar-jayanti-award): A commemorative acrylic award with a gold medallion portrait on an engraved wooden base.
- [Grandparents Day School Award](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/grandparents-day-school-award): A colourful, UV-printed keepsake that schools can present to grandparents on Grandparents Day.
- [Shrinathji Bhagwat Katha Honour](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/shrinathji-bhagwat-katha-honour): A devotional honour piece featuring Shrinathji, made for katha and religious events with a personalised base plate.
- [Industries Association Chief Guest Award](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/industries-association-chief-guest-award): A layered honour award for chief guests, with printed backdrop, cutout photo and engraved dedication.
- [Red Cross Society Honour Plaque](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/red-cross-society-honour-plaque): A framed wooden honour plaque with photo, organisation logo and engraved citation.
- [Tricolour Honour Plaque](https://sheetallaserartgallery.com/products/tricolour-honour-plaque): A mirror-finish honour plaque with tricolour map cutouts, portrait frame and personalised message.
